# What a user's plugin cache receives: the `dist` branch is built from exactly
# these paths (scripts/dist/build.sh). Everything else in this repository - the
# evaluation bench, the evals, the gates that guard the repository, the docs -
# stays here. One path per line, relative to the repository root; a directory
# ships whole. A path the plugin reads at run time and that is missing here
# breaks the installed plugin, which is why build.sh smoke-tests the result.
